rationale: Freeze the fake-subprocess-only provider-native adapter contract after the existing synthetic execution baseline. The new public seam must preserve the final admission-marker-process order for exactly codex1/codex2 and agy1/agy2, build only Codex read-only or AGY plan+sandbox argv, parse one native structured terminal WorkResult, and return admission-bound receipt data plus digest-only output evidence. It must reject raw, malformed, ambiguous or missing-final streams and nonzero DONE output, accept a nonzero typed failure only, never retry/fallback, and never persist provider streams or secrets. Ordinary activation remains CLOSED.
